infobox.usage: Unlocks the back door of the eastern cottage on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Cottage back door key (Cottage) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the back door to one of the cottages, located somewhere near the Azure Coast sanatorium.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Used in Therapists quest Tarkov-Style Diplomacy

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Shoreline
sections.text:
- In the yard of the locked villa, on top of the bundled barrels.

- In a key rack in the unlocked villa.

- In a key rack in the garage of house no. 5 located in the eastern part of the west village.

- In a key rack in the barn of house no. 4 located in the eastern part of the west village.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Back door of the eastern cottage on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Yellow keycard spawn location
- 1x PC block
- 3x Sports bag
- 2x Gun cabinet
- 2x Safe (one locked)
- 1x Jacket
- Loose loot (Valuables, Provisions, Currency, Building materials, Others)
- Kalashnikov AKS-74U 5.45x39 assault rifle spawn on the couch
- Random Weapon spawn on a bed upstairs
